format: WSDC Registry Events, untampered judging and scoring

source.edition: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
source.section: 1.1 item 6 (PDF p.4); contest oversight item 5.b (PDF p.19, cited as 3.4.5.b)
source.quote_free_summary: Event owners provide fair, unbiased and untampered competitions, judging and scoring; judges decide independently and tampering with or altering contest scores is not allowed.

requirement: No person other than the judge alters the judge's marks; the judge's own correction is bound, confirmed and fully audited.
interpretation_notes: Whether a judge's own later correction counts as altering contest scores is NOT SPECIFIED; the DanceFlow design treats an unconfirmed alteration by anyone as prohibited and a bound judge confirmation as the permitted exception, pending owner confirmation. 1.1 item 6 is an owner obligation, not a correction procedure. Design only: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
